review.rationale: Option A correctly bounds the next step to a new remediation candidate derived from the frozen candidate commit, preserving immutability of the existing candidate, evidence refs, and PR topology. The seven allowed paths are sufficient and necessary to cover the five required corrections (D-B03, D-B04, D-S01, D-S02, D-S03) without expanding scope; D-B05 is explicitly excluded from correction effect, preventing scope creep into README changes. The schema companion and existing test path modifications are justified solely to maintain machine contract consistency and regression coverage for the site metadata/footer changes, not to introduce new capabilities. Target status values accurately reflect the historical state of the source candidate at the frozen commit without falsely elevating authority or implying merge/release approval. Validation and stop conditions are comprehensive, covering source binding, JSON/schema consistency, site regression, CE tests, and exact-model review with no retry/fallback. The recommended Decision boundary remains strictly narrower than evidence execution, PR mutation, merge, release, or deployment, requiring separate decisions for each subsequent governance step.
